commits.subject: Name Smokum-Regular as the release does
commits.body:
The release's names differ from what FontForge exported from this file;
it states them as US English names: ID 4 'Smokum Regular' (FontForge exported 'Smokum').

disclose: The released font has only a legacy `kern` table and no GPOS. fontc writes kerning as GPOS, and a font with GPOS no longer gets HarfBuzz's built-in placement of combining marks, so combining marks are positioned differently from the release (also: pairs starting with the soft hyphen U+00AD kern differently). Decided 2026-10-01: accept and disclose.
